samples.question: The sheet carries exactly one solid slate-grey patch, and exactly one square window of sheet colour is cut out of the interior of that patch. Every other mark on the sheet, in any other colour, is decorative and must be ignored. Take the area of that square window as one unit of area, and take the slate ink still present after the window is cut as the measured area. How many whole units of area does the slate ink cover, that is, the largest whole number of window-areas that fits inside the slate ink area? Answer with a single integer.
